field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 and final activity rows were independently checked. The final activity file covers 31 source-reviewable MIC rows, preserves the daptomycin CaCl2/microdilution context, excludes slash/no-value cells, and avoids promoting unsupported 95% in vivo figure-label text as exact survival.

Fallback DBAASP machine rows remain excluded from authoritative ingest, but the current database final still carries stale validation fields asserting 12 final-mirror sequence/placeholder issues and a worker6 rebuild blocker although the live recursive final-record sequence audit found zero objects containing both sequence and sequence_length.

Every final JSON was enumerated in paper and packet mirrors. All intended mirror pairs match except mechanism_evidence.json: the paper final is the older 2026-07-27T19:15:01Z object, while the packet final is the later 2026-07-27T19:52:27Z object and byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json.

field_checks.summary: Mechanism claims were checked against XML/PDF and supplement surfaces. Direct mechanism strength is limited to YZ462 membrane integrity/potential/permeability, SEM morphology, and ITC PE/CL binding; ROS and biofilm remain phenotypic/contextual, and daptomycin fallback rows are not promoted to direct mechanism evidence.

Paper identity is source-confirmed as PMCID PMC12606902, PMID 41219701, DOI 10.1186/s12866-025-04475-6, BMC Microbiology 2025. YZ462 and daptomycin are separated, but daptomycin database identity remains unresolved and excluded from authoritative promotion.

Locator index and extracted source surfaces were reviewed. Most final source locators resolve or are deliberate table-coordinate derivatives; two nonblocking classes remain: an explicit unresolved supplement figure exclusion and candidate database-row provenance outside the primary locator index.

Recursive authority is not asserted, final database rows are not source_verified, authoritative DBAASP ingest is false, and fallback machine rows remain candidate-only rather than RC2/portal/authoritative ingest material.

The accepted caution that no authoritative linked DBAASP rows exist is preserved. However, stale database validation-summary blocker text and the mechanism mirror mismatch mean the current strict acceptance artifact cannot be treated as terminal publication-grade evidence.

Both staged supplements were independently inspected. MOESM1 is recovered as a tab-delimited transcriptomics table; MOESM2 text, tables, and embedded-object text surface are recovered with supplementary_unparsed_embedded_object_count=0.

Quantitative cytotoxicity, hemolysis, acute toxicity, body weight, and Galleria LD50 are covered, but the HEK293T/HeLa PI uptake selectivity surface for eukaryotic membrane permeability in Fig. S7 is omitted from final toxicity records and exclusions.
